h: FG plans 167 new CNG stations, sets gas price at ₦430
p: The federal government has unveiled plans for 167 compressed natural gas refuelling stations across Nigeria to give motorists a cheaper alternative to petrol. A CNG price of ₦430 was highlighted.
body: The federal government has unveiled plans to build 167 compressed natural gas (CNG) refuelling stations across Nigeria, as part of efforts to make cheaper transport fuel more widely available and reduce dependence on petrol.
A presentation on the initiative reportedly highlighted a CNG price of ₦430, alongside plans to expand refuelling infrastructure and tackle challenges facing the sector.
The new stations are expected to improve access to CNG for motorists, especially commercial transport operators looking for alternatives to petrol, whose price has remained high.
more: A CNG price of ₦430 was highlighted.
The plan targets commercial transport operators.
